.DISCUSSION...

Temperatures near normal today, then cooler 
than normal Friday into this weekend. Scattered showers and 
thunderstorms today as a weather system moves into the state. 
Wind speeds mostly less than 15 mph this week except for today 
with southwest winds around 15 to 20 mph. Minimum relative 
humidity remains above 25-40+ percent in the valleys through the
week.
